text.jp:
たくさんの参拝者や神殿の兵士、
それに神官たちまで……
text.official_en:
Lots of worshippers, temple soldiers, and even some
priests have vanished over the years.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ

こんなに人目がある場所で、失踪した人は
どこに消えてしまったのかしら？
text.official_en:
Where could they have disappeared to? This is a very
public place. It shouldn't be possible.

カストールさんの病気のことって、
うちの母さんは知ってたのかな。
text.official_en: I wonder if my mom already knew Castor was sick.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……多分、知ってたんだろうね。
処刑のことも、なにもかも。
text.official_en:
She probably did. Probably already knew about the
death sentence too, I bet.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
秘密を知ったうえで、ぼくたちに全然
そんな事を感じさせなかったんだ。
text.official_en:
She probably knew all those secrets, but didn't let us
kids know about any of it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
なんかさ……
変なところですごいね、大人って。
text.official_en:
Grown-ups are weird. But they're awesome too,
right? I mean, they're still weird...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……そうだね、そんなことより、
今は神殿の中をしらべないとね。
text.official_en:
Well, we should probably get back to searching
the temple.

text.official_en: <TH>

神殿内の調査、お願いね。
頼りにしているわ、カイくん。
text.official_en:
Cai, I'm trusting you to handle the search of the
temple's interior.
text.real_en:
Kai, I'm trusting you to handle the search of the
temple's interior.

わたくしはここから出られないから、
気になるものを見つけたら戻ってきてね。

Since I cannot leave my chambers, I ask that you
please come tell me about anything of interest.

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
見張りの門番によれば、消えた神官は
この神殿の外には出ていないとのことです。
text.official_en:
It was a priest who vanished. The gatekeeper on
duty confirmed he didn't see the person leave.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もしも賊がいるとすれば、神殿内に
何らかの痕跡が残っている筈なのです。
text.official_en:
If bandits are behind this, they'd have been noticed
by someone—or have left a trace of their crime.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
昔の記録によれば、最初の失踪事件が
起こったのは、今から８０年前とのことで。
text.official_en:
I've been reading old temple records, and the first
disappearance occurred 80 years ago.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そして、その翌年には神官や参拝者などの
失踪事件が立て続けに起こっています。
text.official_en:
The year after that, priests, worshippers, and several
temple visitors all vanished in quick succession.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そのときには、大変な騒ぎとなったようです。
ですが、結局、誰にも何もわからぬまま……
text.official_en:
There was an enormous commotion about it all, but
no one was able to solve the mystery.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ここのところは失踪者は減っていたのですが。
はたして、同一犯の犯行なのでしょうか……？
text.official_en:
In recent years, it's happened less and less often. So,
who's really behind it—one person, all this time?

関係があるかどうかわからないけれど、わたし、
この神殿で変な感じになることがあるの。
text.official_en:
I hate admitting it, but sometimes the temple has...
I don't know. I've just had weird feelings in here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド

text.jp:
時々、誰も居るはずがない時に
人の気配を感じることがあったり、
text.official_en:
Sometimes, even though there couldn't have been
anyone there, I've been sure I wasn't alone.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この間も、誰かに名前を呼ばれた気がして
振り返ったけど誰も居ないってことがあって……
text.official_en:
There's been times when I'd swear I heard a voice
call my name, but there'd be no one else around.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ウルタンド
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……やだ、思い出してたら、なんだか
ちょっと怖くなってきちゃったわ。

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
神殿の中で人が消えたっていうんで、こうやって
俺たちも調査に駆り出されてるんだが……
text.official_en:
People have long vanished from this temple. We've
been sent to help with the investigation this time.

text.jp:
ここだけの話、実は犯人はアウロラ様で、
失踪した人間は食われてるって噂もあるんだ。
text.official_en:
Between you and me, there's a rumor that Aurora
has been eating the people that disappeared.

text.jp:
ほら、なにしろアウロラ様はあの
バロールの血を引くお方だからなあ……
text.official_en: And, you know, she does have Balor's blood in her.

text.jp:
ところで、ぼうずたちも災難だったな。
今日はここに参拝にきてたんだろう？
text.official_en:
Hey, did you kids come today to offer prayers or
something? That's too bad...

text.jp:
手がかりを見つけるまで外には蟻一匹出すなって
お達しだから、今日は家に帰れないかもな……
text.official_en:
We aren't to let anybody leave until we sort what's
happening. You might not be able to go home today.

みんなみんな……
楽園に行ってしまったのさ……

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミワイ
US EN person identifier agrees

ここにいると……白き谷……
神々の楽園ザナドに連れて行かれちまう……

Stay here too long, and you may join them in the
paradise of the gods, White Canyon Zanado.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミワイ
US EN person identifier agrees

儂がそれを言っても、
誰も取り合ってくれん……

*sigh* Nobody pays attention when I talk about
these things.

text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミワイ

みんな楽園に連れていかれちまう！

All of them, they're all taken to paradise! I can never
do anything to stop it!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ

I suppose that I've been running from him ever

Cai, I'm glad to see you. I've learned a great deal

If we accept that Drake's treasures are truly pieces
of Balor's corpse, then...

所有者は、遺骸を通じて冥界の場が持つ力を

the power of these treasures is likely drawn up
from the underworld, via the corpse.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ティアラ

だけど……そんな強すぎる力を普通の人間が

using such power.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル

text.jp:
なあ、カイ……
………………いや、やっぱり面白くもねえ。
text.official_en: Cai... I don't know what to say. This isn't funny.
text.real_en: Kai... I don't know what to say. This isn't funny.

text.jp:
今日はもう帰れ。
しばらく来なくていいからな。
text.official_en:
Just go home for today, will you? And...maybe don't
worry about coming back for a while.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あの後、必死になってレダ様に頭を下げてな。
ひとまずは許してもらうことが出来た。
text.official_en:
After what happened, I went immediately to milady
and apologized. She has forgiven me for now.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……姫に関しては、
これで何かが解決したわけではないが、
text.official_en:
I doubt this has resolved Lady Leda's desire
for revenge.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ほんの少しだけでも、立ち止まることは出来よう。
あの方には今、そういった時間が必要なのだ。
text.official_en:
But it will slow her, if just for a while. A pause that I
believe will serve her.

text.jp:
カイ、お前にはすっかり世話をかけてしまったな。
改めて、礼を言わせてくれ。
text.official_en:
You've been a great help, Cai. Allow me to
thank you.
text.real_en:
You've been a great help, Kai. Allow me to
thank you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
君たちは何者だ……？
教えてくれ……今日は……いつなんだ？
text.official_en: Who are you? What day is it?

text.jp:
昨日と同じ今日を生きて……今日と同じ
明日をまた生きて……もう気が狂いそうだ……
text.official_en:
Today feels like yesterday, while tomorrow feels
the same as today. Maybe I've lost my mind.

text.jp:
……そうだ、ミワイは？
あの子は、どこにいってしまったんだ……？
text.official_en: Where is Morrow? Where has my little boy gone?
text.real_en: Where is Miwai? Where has my little boy gone?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ここは楽園……ここは安らぎの場所……
わたしたち家族は、ここで穏やかに過ごすの……
text.official_en:
I get to live with my family in paradise! It's so
peaceful here.

text.jp:
……どうしてそんな顔をしているの？
あなたたちは、しあわせじゃないの？
text.official_en:
Why are you making that face? You don't look happy
for me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
……おかしいな、どうして僕は
こんなところにいるんだろう……
text.official_en: Huh? How did I get here?

text.jp:
僕は、家族と一緒にアウロラ神殿に参拝に来て、
それから……それから……
text.official_en:
I came with my family to offer prayers to Aurora
and then... Um, after that we... After that...
